patches.name: DHU adapter
patches.description: Adapts the app to an automotive head unit (Zeekr DHU) with a high resolution screen that reports a low density: readable single-DPI scaling, floating back/settings button and the opt-in compatibility fixes of zeekr-adapt. Uses Pine framework hooks installed from android:appComponentFactory before Application.onCreate. Preset: automotive de-mask (isAutomotiveOS → false, blank screen fix).

options.title: Display / UI
options.description: Category 1. Raises the density the app perceives, recomputes screen dp from the real usable pixels, unlocks orientation, adds the floating back/settings button, rounded corners, WebView text zoom and user agent. Disable for a bare shell (--no-display).

options.title: Rendering DPI
options.description: Density used for DisplayMetrics (rendering). Bigger means a larger UI. Keep it equal to the layout DPI. Can also be changed at runtime in the settings panel.

options.title: Layout DPI
options.description: Density written into Configuration (resource and layout selection). zeekr-adapt keeps it equal to the rendering DPI, a split density breaks fixed-size views.

options.title: Unlock orientation
options.description: Turns every Activity.setRequestedOrientation call into UNSPECIFIED, so portrait-locked apps follow the landscape head unit (--no-orientation disables it).

options.title: Fullscreen
options.description: Hides the system bars in every activity. Off by default, the dp recompute accounts for the visible bars.

options.title: Floating button
options.description: Draggable floating button in every activity. Tap: back, long press: settings panel (DPI, button size, alpha, color, restart).

options.title: Floating button opens settings only
options.description: The button shows the current DPI and a tap opens the settings panel instead of going back.

options.title: Floating button size (dp)
options.description: Size of the floating button, 24 to 96 dp.

options.title: Floating button opacity
options.description: Opacity of the floating button, 0.05 to 1.0.

options.title: Floating button color
options.description: Color of the floating button as #RRGGBB.

options.title: Rounded corners
options.description: Clips the activity content to rounded corners.

options.title: Corner radius (dp)
options.description: Radius of the rounded corners.

options.title: Font override
options.description: File name of a font inside the app's assets/fonts/ to apply to every TextView. Empty: off.

options.title: WebView user agent
options.description: Returned by WebSettings.getDefaultUserAgent. Fixes web-rendered maps rejected by tile servers. Empty: keep the system user agent.
options.default: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13; Pixel 5) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36

options.title: Root bypass
options.description: Category 2. Hides root and su from the app: Build.TAGS, File.exists, Runtime.exec, ProcessBuilder, PackageManager and root SystemProperties. For apps that refuse to run on rooted or userdebug head units.

options.title: Emulator bypass
options.description: Category 3. De-genericises Build.* and qemu/goldfish SystemProperties.

options.title: Automotive de-mask
options.description: Category 4. isAutomotiveOS() and hasSystemFeature(automotive) return false, UiModeManager reports NORMAL, Configuration.uiMode loses CAR and the Android Auto connection query is blocked. Fixes the blank/white screen of car-aware apps.

options.title: Network bypass
options.description: Category 5a. NetworkCapabilities.hasCapability/hasTransport and NetworkInfo.isConnected report connected (head unit internet over Ethernet/TBOX without Android validation).

options.title: SIM ready
options.description: Category 5b. getSimState returns READY and key_use_cellular_data reads true. Harmful to SIM-aware apps such as phone number registration.

options.title: Zeekr MediaCenter bridge
options.description: Category 6. Registers the app's MediaSession with ZeekrMediaCenterService: steering wheel control, cover art, metadata and reboot resume. Adds CoverProvider, RecoveryReceiver and the com.zeekr.mediacenter package query. Media apps only.

options.title: Allow screen capture
options.description: Category 7. Strips FLAG_SECURE so the screen can be captured or mirrored.

options.title: Debug logging
options.description: Category 8. Verbose logs, read with adb logcat -s DhuAdapter.

options.title: Copy original signature
options.description: Category 9. Stores the genuine signer certificate of the original APK and returns it to the app's own signature self-check. Requires the original, store-signed APK.
